The account “%1$s” was created. Save Mystaccount.json somewhere safe, such as Downloads or Drive. It stores your profile, playlists, history, statistics, and Discord connection, and lets you sign in again after reinstalling the app. Keep it like a key: anyone with the file can access the linked Myst and Discord accounts.
Account saved automatically on your phone. The copy path appears in Settings → Myst account.

MystMusic saves Mystaccount.json automatically in /sdcard/MystMusic so you do not lose playlists, history, and settings when signing out or reinstalling. To write to that folder, Android needs storage access. If you decline, the copy is still made in Download/MystMusic.

The selected Mystaccount.json restores the Myst account profile, playlists, history, and Discord connection. If the account already exists on this device, the data is merged without erasing current data. The YouTube session is not restored and will be requested next.

Playback stops, temporary data is erased, and the TV returns to the 5-digit code screen. The phone can stay paired and be disconnected in its own settings.

Android only shows an app\'s logs to external readers with the READ_LOGS permission, granted through ADB or root. To view logs without ADB, use this screen or the Share button.

Rich Presence uses a Discord user token through an unofficial connection. This falls in a gray area of Discord\'s terms and may lead to account suspension. Enable it only if you accept the risk. To show the cover, MystMusic uses Discord\'s media proxy through a public open-source application; no application is created on your account. MystMusic works normally without it.
